0022600159.text: The Detroit Pistons (5-1, 1st in the Central and 1st in the East, on a two-game win streak) visit the Charlotte Hornets (3-3, 3rd in the Southeast and 8th in the East) in their seventh game of the season, with Detroit 3-1 on the road and Charlotte on a two-game losing streak. Detroit leads the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after its 97-89 win in Detroit on October 28, and the Pistons also won the 2025-26 series 3-0. Detroit will be without Isaiah Joe (hip bruise) and Jalen Duren (hamstring strain), while Charlotte is missing Coby White (calf strain), Grant Williams (hamstring), Kon Knueppel (hamstring), and Kylan Boswell (knee, surgery).
